subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's bounded per-reply provider quota lookup as the canonical `/usage` footer behavior, or require a cached/preloaded quota design before landing?
rationale: The implementation shape is narrow, but it changes reply delivery latency behavior around provider quota fetching and intentionally omits quota text on slow cold lookups.

options.title: Review and land linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96339 as the canonical fix if the 2.5s omit-on-timeout behavior is acceptable.

options.title: Require cached quota design
options.body: Ask the linked PR to prefetch or cache provider usage so cold quota lookups do not usually miss the per-response footer.

options.title: Keep quota in status only
options.body: Reject per-response quota display and leave provider quota windows in `/status` and CLI status surfaces only.

recommendation.title: Review and land linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96339 as the canonical fix if the 2.5s omit-on-timeout behavior is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on provider-usage/status plumbing and already scoped this issue in prior review context.
